name: Seven Superyachts
lede: From two heaters on a production motor yacht to nine across three decks of a 63-metre Benetti, Platinum Electric Marine heaters let owners use their outdoor decks in every season and at every latitude.

photos.caption: Aft deck dining on M/Y Lady Charlotte. Photograph from Bromic’s marine presentation (2022).
A ceiling-mounted heater on M/Y Cloudbreak. Photograph from Bromic’s marine presentation (2022).

beats: Seven yachts from Feadship, Abeking & Rasmussen, Benetti, Amels, Turquoise and Ocean Alexander, cruising from the Mediterranean to the polar regions.
Owners and guests wanted their outdoor decks in use in every season and at every latitude.

Every yacht carries Platinum Smart-Heat Electric Marine heaters, from two on the OA100 to nine on Metis. On Emocean four are recessed into the deck heads; on Lady Charlotte six warm the outdoor dining area.
